name: Dub techno
key_tendency: Minor 7th and minor 9th chords on one root (C minor, F minor); the chord barely changes.
signature: Offbeat minor 9th chord stab drowned in delay and reverb
Slowly moving low-pass filter on the stab over 16 bars or more
Soft kick, quiet hats, a lot of air
Deep sine sub bass following the root
Vinyl crackle and hiss as texture
listen_for: The stab is short, but its delay tail fills the whole bar. Listen to the filter opening and closing so slowly it feels like weather.

parts.bass:
const bass = note("<c1 c1 f1 c1>").struct("x ~ ~ x ~ ~ x ~").s("sine")
  .decay(0.3).sustain(0.2).lpf(200).gain(0.6)

starter.arrange:
arrange(
  [16, stack(chords, fx, drums.mask("<0 1>/8"))],
  [32, stack(drums, bass, chords, fx)],
  [16, stack(drums.mask("1 0 1 0"), bass, chords.room(0.95), fx)],
)
